title: 第十五章 生死时速第十六章 崖边魔渊
lines: 第十五章：生死时速
叶重拼了命的飞奔，留下了一道模糊的残影，其时不时向后抛射着灰铁豺的牙齿，像子弹般向黎力射去，阻挡着黎力前进的步伐。紧追其后的黎力，一边躲闪着叶重发过来的牙齿暗器，一边面色狰狞的追逐着与其距离越来越近的叶重，双方的距离正在不断的缩小。
感应着黎力的不断逼近，叶重低骂道：“他速度比我快，这样下去迟早会被他赶上。与其坐以待毙，还不如主动出击，为自己搏得一线生机！”。
叶重与黎力二人的速度太快了，仅仅数次飞窜，就离原地有了数百米。不过盏茶的功夫，他们二人奔跑到了天鹰峰的一片山崖边缘。
“嗖！”，叶重双腿一发力，瞬时蹬地而起。随即只见叶重从山崖边上一跃而出，飞过半空，朝远处对面的另一座大山跃过去。
“哼！”，看着跳崖而过的叶重，黎力也是元气裹腿，随即同样双脚一蹬，瞬间冲出高山，猛然一跃，朝着叶重继续追杀而来。
“蓬！”，只见叶重双腿一弯，脚掌一跺，双臂一展竟如鹏鸟飞跃一般，一跃，过了近三十米。
在死亡危机的压迫下，以及“八步蝉”这门步法的辅助，叶重瞬时直接跳过那三十米来宽的崖沟，轰然落在对面的另外一座大山的半山腰上。叶重双脚落处，使得地面都是猛然一震，随即叶重却是头也不回的，毫不犹豫的继续向前方高速飞窜而去。
“蓬！”，紧随而来的黎力，也随后落在这半山腰之上，继续疯狂向叶重追逐而去。
一追一逃，二人的速度，都飙到了极限。
高山、河流、悬崖，对叶重二人而言都如同平地般平坦，不见他们的速度有丝毫的减缓。
使用完灰铁豺牙齿的叶重，甚至在飞窜时，横腿一扫旁边的一块巨石，使得巨石直接飞起，瞬时砸向后面的黎力。可黎力却身形一闪，仅仅一个纵身跳跃，随即脚掌踩在巨石之上，借巨石的反弹之力，继续朝叶重追了过去。
黎力可不会傻乎乎的去打碎这块巨石，因为那样会花费更多的时间，从而会拉大自己和叶重之间的距离；而且这样还会浪费自己体内丹田中所剩不多的元气。
无论是黎力还是叶重，都是很清楚这一点：不浪费每一份实力，全力去对付敌人，才是明智之举。
叶重与黎力双方的距离，正在不断缩短。才几炷香的时间，叶重他们二人跑过了五座大山。在叶重刚从第六座大山一跃而出时，黎力就随后追到了。
在离地半米的空中，二人又一次开始了短暂的交锋。
只见二人脚掌一撞，落地的叶重继续向前奔去。落地的黎力扭了扭有些发麻的左脚，也是紧跟而上。
“嗤嗤。”，叶重转身面对黎力，手中拿着几块石子，向着黎力的面门射去。
在半空中，黎力带着飞冲的势头，身形化作一道白色光线，一个滑步闪躲了过去。叶重嘴唇一咬，刚要用手掌去抵挡黎力的长拳，欲要硬碰硬。可黎力却身姿一转，根本不给叶重与自己的肉体硬碰硬的机会。
吃过叶重暗亏的黎力，在转身的瞬间却是暗骂道：“这小子是什么怪胎，他肉体的力量怎么如此之大！除非元气裹身，否则我的身体，根本承受不住他的一击！长此以往，只怕死的就是我了！”。
黎力不得不承认，虽然叶重是一个连元轮都没形成的废物。但叶重的强大，却足以让他全力以赴容不得半点马虎。而且黎力很清楚，一旦硬碰硬，黎力会遭受反震力道而速度大减，而叶重反而可以借力又跑出一大截，从而拉大两人之间的距离，这招叶重可是使了不止一次。
三年来，叶重的修为虽因为元轮破碎而毫无寸进，但得益于铸轮方汤药和自己三年风雨不断的打磨，叶重的肉体强度和力量，甚至超过沈泰这种武宗强者，比黎力这种武师高手更是强了不止一筹。
有元气之助的黎力，也只能将元气裹于双手或者双脚，才能将叶重打伤，否则只能自讨苦吃。而叶重在经过几次交手后，却根本不给黎力与他硬碰硬的机会。掌控战斗节奏的叶重，总是会朝黎力没有被元气包裹的身体部位攻击。使得元气有限的黎力，也是暗恨不已，不过这却加强了黎力杀叶重的决心。
黎力很清楚，如果此次叶重得以逃脱。那么自己将永远都没有机会杀叶重，并且叶重还会使得自己花费了十几年心血的谋划功亏一篑。甚至黎力都不怀疑，有朝一日，自己都会身亡于叶重之手。
“想要与我硬碰硬，然后一点一滴的磨杀死我？”，叶重冷笑一声，随即手臂瞬时化作了一道弧线，手如长枪，拳如枪尖，仿佛流水漩涡般不断的旋转着，随后化作快如闪电的袭击，向黎力腰间袭去。
这八卦门炮拳，曾被一代华夏古武宗师“枪王”李书文当做拿手绝技，打得群雄皆服。在叶重手中，也是让其与黎力打了个势均力敌，不落下风。

Chapter 15: Speed of Life and Death
Ye Zhong ran with all his strength, leaving behind a blurry afterimage. From time to time, it threw the gray iron jackal's teeth backwards, shooting towards Li Li like bullets, blocking Li Li's progress. Li Li, who was chasing after him, dodged the hidden tooth weapon sent by Ye Zhong while chasing Ye Zhong with a ferocious look on his face, who was getting closer and closer to him. The distance between the two sides was constantly shrinking.
Sensing Li Li's constant approach, Ye Zhong cursed lowly: "He is faster than me, and sooner or later he will catch up if this continues. Instead of sitting back and waiting for death, it is better to take the initiative and fight for a chance of survival for yourself!".
Ye Zhong and Li Li were so fast that they were hundreds of meters away from where they were in just a few flights. In the time it took to drink tea, the two of them ran to the edge of a cliff at Tianying Peak.
"Whoosh!" Ye Zhong used his legs and instantly kicked off the ground. Immediately, Ye Zhong jumped out from the edge of the cliff, flew through the air, and jumped towards another large mountain opposite in the distance.
"Humph!" Looking at Ye Zhong jumping over the cliff, Li Li also wrapped his legs with vitality, and then kicked off his feet, rushed out of the mountain in an instant, jumped suddenly, and continued to pursue Ye Zhong.
"Peng!" Ye Zhong bent his legs, stamped his feet, and spread his arms like a bird leaping, leaping nearly thirty meters.
Under the pressure of the danger of death, and with the assistance of the "Eight-step Cicada" footwork, Ye Zhong instantly jumped over the thirty-meter-wide cliff ditch and landed on the middle of another mountain on the opposite side. Where Ye Zhong's feet landed, the ground shook suddenly, but Ye Zhong did not look back and continued to fly forward at high speed without hesitation.
"Peng!" Li Li, who followed closely, landed on the mountainside and continued to chase Ye Zhong crazily.
One chasing and the other escaping, the speed of the two reached the limit.
Mountains, rivers, and cliffs were all as flat as flat ground to Ye Zhong and the others, and their speed did not slow down at all.
After using the gray iron jackal's teeth, Ye Zhong even swept a boulder next to him with his cross leg while flying, causing the boulder to fly up and instantly hit Li Li behind him. But Li Li flashed, just jumped, and then stepped on the boulder with his soles. Using the rebound power of the boulder, he continued to chase Ye Chong.
Li Li would not be stupid enough to break this boulder, because it would take more time and widen the distance between him and Ye Zhong; and it would also waste the little energy left in his Dantian.
Both Li Li and Ye Zhong are very clear about this: it is wise not to waste every strength and go all out to deal with the enemy.
The distance between Ye Chong and Li Li is constantly shortening. In just a few sticks of incense, Ye Chong and the others ran across five mountains. When Ye Chong just jumped out of the sixth mountain, Li Li caught up with him.
Half a meter above the ground, the two began a brief confrontation again.
The two feet collided, and Ye Zhong, who landed on the ground, continued to run forward. Li Li, who landed on the ground, twisted his numb left foot and followed closely.
"Chichi." Ye Zhong turned around to face Li Li, holding a few stones in his hand and shooting towards Li Li's face.
In mid-air, Li Li turned into a white light with the momentum of flying, and dodged it with a sliding step. Ye Zhong bit his lip and was about to use his palm to resist Li Li's long fist, wanting to fight head-on. But Li Li turned around and didn't give Ye Zhong a chance to come into contact with his body.
Li Li, who had suffered a secret loss from Ye Zhong, cursed secretly when he turned around: "What kind of freak is this kid? How come his physical strength is so great! Unless the vitality is wrapped around me, my body will not be able to withstand his blow! If this continues, I will be the one who dies!".
Li Li had to admit that although Ye Zhong was a waste who hadn't even formed a Yuan Wheel. But Ye Zhong was powerful enough to make him go all out and not tolerate any sloppiness. Moreover, Li Li knew very well that in the event of a head-on collision, Li Li would suffer from the force of the shock and his speed would be greatly reduced. However, Ye Zhong could use the force to run a lot further, thus widening the distance between the two. Ye Zhong used this trick more than once.
In the past three years, although Ye Zhong's cultivation has made no progress due to the broken Yuan Lun, but thanks to the wheel-casting decoction and his three years of continuous hard work, Ye Zhong's physical strength and strength have even surpassed that of a martial arts master like Shen Tai, and is more than a step ahead of a martial arts master like Li Li.
With the help of vitality, Li Li could only injure Ye Zhong by wrapping his vitality in his hands or feet, otherwise he would have to ask for trouble. But after Ye Zhong fought several times, he didn't give Li Li a chance to confront him head-on. Ye Zhong, who controlled the rhythm of the battle, would always attack Li Li's body parts that were not wrapped in vitality. Li Li, who had limited vitality, secretly resented it, but this strengthened Li Li's determination to kill Ye Zhong.
Li Li knew very well that if Ye Chong could escape this time. Then he would never have the chance to kill Ye Zhong, and Ye Zhong would also make the plan he had spent more than ten years of hard work come to nothing. Even Li Li did not doubt that one day he would die at the hands of Ye Chong.
"You want to confront me head-on, and then kill me bit by bit?" Ye Zhong sneered, and then his arm instantly turned into an arc. His hand was like a spear, and his fist was like the tip of the spear. It was constantly spinning like a whirlpool of water, and then turned into a lightning-fast attack, attacking Li Li's waist.
This Baguamen gun boxing was once regarded as a special skill by Li Shuwen, the "gun king" of a generation of ancient Chinese martial arts masters, and he won the hearts of all the heroes. In Ye Zhong's hands, he was evenly matched with Li Li and did not fall behind.
